description: Use when you need to check a phone number from any country: valid and possible against allocated ranges, E.164 and national format, country, and line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, toll-free, premium) with an SMS-capable hint. National numbers need a country, e.g. 0612345678 with country=NL. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

country.description: ISO country for national numbers, e.g. NL

name: phone_verify
title: Validate a phone number (paid)
